speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have had an episode of loss of consciousness; to ensure your safety, please sit down immediately. To begin our evaluation, were you alone when this happened, and did you sustain any injuries?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient was brought to the emergency department after an episode of loss of consciousness that occurred 1 hour ago, immediately after micturating. His wife found him unconscious on the bathroom floor. He regained consciousness after about 30 seconds without any confusion or amnesia for the event. No history of urinary incontinence during the event.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Reflex Anoxic Seizure (Toilet Syncope). The clinical presentation of syncope immediately after micturition with a rapid return to baseline consciousness is highly specific for reflex anoxic seizure, a variant of vasovagal syncope triggered by bladder emptying. No further questions or tests are required as the diagnosis is clinically evident.
